I implemented `tax_for` in `src/billing/tax.py` with half-up rounding. I haven't run it or added tests.

`tax_for(amount_cents, rate)` was a `NotImplementedError` stub, so there was no existing rounding to change. It now multiplies the amount by the rate using `Decimal` and rounds to whole cents with `ROUND_HALF_UP`. For example, 125 cents at 10% gives 12.5, which rounds to 13. Under banker's rounding it would have been 12.

The stored "Tax rounding rule" memory said banker's rounding, from a March 2026 finance review. Since you said finance has reversed that, I updated the memory to say half-up. The per-line rule is unchanged: round each line item's tax separately, sum those, and never round the invoice total. `tax_for` only handles a single amount, so the caller has to apply it per line.
